source.text: Ray Enright( March 25, 1896 – April 3, 1965) was an American film director. He directed 73 films between 1927 – 53, many of them for Warner Bros. He oversaw comedy films like Joe E. Brown vehicles, and five of the six informal pairings of Joan Blondell and Glenda Farrell. Enright was born in Anderson, Indiana, and died in Hollywood, California, from a heart attack.
source.title: Ray Enright

source.text: Kid Gloves is a 1929 American pre-Code part-talkie drama film directed by Ray Enright, and starring Conrad Nagel, Lois Wilson, Edward Earle, Edna Murphy, and Maude Turner Gordon. The film was released by Warner Bros. on March 23, 1929.
source.title: Kid Gloves (film)
